prepare.success_fence: 3600 initial BL8 reads, cache writes, checked completion, no outstanding adapter operation
prepare.integrity_owner: Upstream validates canonical/HUD generation tags and write fences; holds actual memory leases

commit.irreversible_point: Accepted descriptor changes READY to PENDING; cannot be aborted
commit.presentation_fence: presented pulse with front generation/frame/slot after frame_boundary and scanout_drained
commit.old_front_release: Same qualified presentation fence, never ingress ACK or prepared result

abort.inputs: generation64/frame_id32/cache_slot1; exact owned FILL or READY context
abort.completion: abort_done/error after matching DMA command and physical adapter drain

memory.port: lcd_req_valid/ready addr24 x16 aligned8; lcd_rsp_valid/ready data128/error; lcd_abort_i,busy,aborted
memory.layout: tile index row-major; physical tile32 words; row-major8x8 bytes; 4 BL8 per tile
memory.late_response_contract: No successful old response after abort/drain fence; no physical generation echo

cdc.clocks: mem_clk100MHz; pixel_clk nominal29.36MHz, unchanged panel porches
held_payloads: request_line0/1 and request_epoch0/1 held until matching done token
completed_bad0/1 held with completion token until next same-buffer line
dual-clock line RAM: all480 words written before done toggle, never written until next request
synchronizers: frame_toggle synchronization and gray underrun counter
cdc.reset: Coordinated pixel/owner/adapter resets only; no unilateral pixel reset recovery
cdc.physical_gate: Review bundled-data max-delay/skew and synchronizers in selected routed board; component/OOC evidence does not sign off CDC

operational_limits.behavior: Fails closed before wrapping; no silent identity reuse
operational_limits.approximate_exhaustion: Roughly half an hour at ~2.1 million BL8 commands/s; depends on actual command rate
operational_limits.release_gate: Before long-duration release, separately qualify a 64-bit internal-cookie successor with abort/stale tests, or a coordinated owner/backend/pixel reset policy. No unbounded or 20+minute30fps readiness claim.
